original_question: Jerry rebɔ ludu a n'anim yɛ nsia. Ɛdɛn na ɛyɛ paa (a wɔde kyerɛ wɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu) sɛ ɔtow akontaahyɛde a ɛboro 3 so a, ɔtow akontaahyɛde mmienu a emu yɛ baako a edi hɔ?
question_template: {name_male, Jerry} rebɔ ludu a n'anim yɛ {num_text_1, nsia}. Ɛdɛn na ɛyɛ paa (a wɔde kyerɛ wɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu) sɛ ɔtow akontaahyɛde a ɛboro {num_digit_1, 3} so a, ɔtow akontaahyɛde {num_text_2, mmienu} a emu yɛ baako a edi hɔ?
question_solution:
even_count = num_text_1 / 2  # number of even faces
answer = ((num_text_1 - num_digit_1) / num_text_1 - (even_count / num_text_1) ** num_text_2) * 100
